[selected_pilot.GetName]紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺阶段才找到机会，凭借其精准的路线和精彩的超越，[selected_pilot.GetSheHe]一骑绝尘，将对手甩在[selected_pilot.GetHerHis]的离子尾流中。

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

小灰在最后冲刺前一直紧随领头者，随后他爆发出了最后的能量。以精准的线路和精彩的超越，他们领先冲过终点线，将其他选手远远甩在了离子尾流中。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Gray shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

我们的飞行员紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺，然后爆发出最后一股力量。凭借清晰的路线和出色的超越，他们领先并让其他飞船远远落在他们的离子尾流中。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Our pilot shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

label.en: We can learn from our winner!
